title.en: Return minimal signed-in vocabulary answer feedback
title.zh: 以最小响应恢复登录用户词汇答题反馈

purpose.en: Remove the production blocker confirmed after v27: the progress write succeeded, but the browser still waited for an unnecessary full course-library response before showing the server grade and Continue state.
purpose.zh: 消除 v27 后确认的生产阻断：学习进度虽已成功写入，但浏览器仍等待不必要的完整课程词库响应，因而无法及时显示服务器判分与继续状态。

en: Keep all course vocabulary answers server-graded and database-persisted.
Show correct or incorrect feedback and Continue after every choice while Repeat After Me remains off by default.
Keep adaptive graded sentence generation on initial deck loads, where the generated sentences are actually consumed.
zh: 继续由服务器判定并在数据库保存所有课程词汇答案。
每次选项提交后显示正确或错误反馈及继续按钮，同时保持跟读默认关闭。
仅在真正使用生成句子的初始词组加载时保留自适应分级句子生成。

en: Signed-in course vocabulary answer response latency and its regression contract; no Clerk, payment, administrator, sibling-site, or anonymous-cookie behavior.
zh: 登录课程词汇答题响应时间及其回归合同；不影响 Clerk、支付、管理员、兄弟站点或匿名 Cookie 行为。

en: Restrict the vocabulary catalog query to the learner's active cumulative level in D1 instead of filtering unrelated higher levels in application memory.
After each progress write, persist the updated daily summary and return only correctness plus summary to the browser.
Keep the active cards, sentence deck, library, and reports from GET in client state instead of replacing them with a large POST payload.
zh: 在 D1 中把词汇目录查询限制为学员当前累计级别，不再于应用内存中过滤无关的更高级词条。
每次进度写入后保存更新后的日报摘要，并只向浏览器返回正确性及摘要。
在客户端保留 GET 返回的当前词卡、句子、词库和报告，不再用庞大的 POST 响应替换。

en: Run focused server-grading and unified-player contracts, TypeScript, the complete automated suite, D1 migration validation, sensitive-data scan, production-equivalent build, changed-file lint, and shared portfolio gates.

Deploy only through GitHub Actions to Cloudflare and repeat the ordinary test learner's English answer, feedback, Continue, sentence, refresh, and persistence path before resuming the four-language matrix.
zh: 执行服务器判分与统一播放器定向合同、TypeScript、全量自动化、D1 迁移、敏感数据扫描、生产等价构建、修改文件 lint 与共享组合门禁。
仅通过 GitHub Actions 发布至 Cloudflare，并先复测普通测试学员的英语答题、反馈、继续、组句、刷新及持久化，再恢复四语言矩阵。

en: The remaining en/ja/es/it real-learning matrix and observable normal-versus-slow audio timing require the fresh Terra production retest after this deployment.
zh: 剩余英/日/西/意真实学习矩阵及可观察的正常/慢速音频时长，需要在本次发布后由 Terra 重新执行生产验收。

en: Preserve SmartLingo's existing database authority, Repeat After Me default-off behavior, GitHub-to-Cloudflare delivery, and SmartLingo-only data boundaries.
Do not modify any other site, account, credential, payment rail, database binding, or cloud resource.
zh: 保持 SmartLingo 既有数据库权威、跟读默认关闭、GitHub 至 Cloudflare 发布及仅限 SmartLingo 的数据边界。
不修改其他站点、账户、凭据、支付通道、数据库绑定或云资源。
